title.text: How Do Home Care Package Levels Vary by Age?
subtitle: Each cell shows the share of one age group's Home Care Package recipients at that level, 30 June 2025.
Darker cells mean a larger share of that age group receives that package level.

transform.expr: datum["Package Level"]==="Level 1" ? 0 : datum["Package Level"]==="Level 2" ? 1 : datum["Package Level"]==="Level 3" ? 2 : datum["Package Level"]==="Level 4" ? 3 : 4

datum["AgeGroup"]==="100+" ? 0 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="95–99" ? 1 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="90–94" ? 2 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="85–89" ? 3 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="80–84" ? 4 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="75–79" ? 5 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="70–74" ? 6 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="65–69" ? 7 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="60–64" ? 8 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="55–59" ? 9 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="50–54" ? 10 : datum["AgeGroup"]==="0–49" ? 11 : 12

on.update: datum && item().mark.marktype !== 'group' && indexof(item().mark.role, 'legend') < 0 ? {unit: "layer_0", fields: hover_tuple_fields, values: [(item().isVoronoi ? datum.datum : datum)["AgeGroup"], (item().isVoronoi ? datum.datum : datum)["Package Level"]]} : null
modify("hover_store", hover_toggle ? null : hover_tuple, hover_toggle ? null : true, hover_toggle ? hover_tuple : null)

tooltip.signal: {"Age group": isValid(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? isArray(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? join(datum["AgeGroup"], '\n') : datum["AgeGroup"] : ""+datum["AgeGroup"], "Package level": isValid(datum["Package Level"]) ? isArray(datum["Package Level"]) ? join(datum["Package Level"], '\n') : datum["Package Level"] : ""+datum["Package Level"], "Recipients": format(datum["Recipients"], ","), "Total recipients in age group": format(datum["AgeGroupTotal"], ","), "Share of age group (%)": format(datum["PercentageWithinAgeGroup"], ".1f")}

description.signal: "Package Level: " + (isValid(datum["Package Level"]) ? isArray(datum["Package Level"]) ? join(datum["Package Level"], ' ') : datum["Package Level"] : ""+datum["Package Level"]) + "; AgeGroup: " + (isValid(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? isArray(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? join(datum["AgeGroup"], ' ') : datum["AgeGroup"] : ""+datum["AgeGroup"]) + "; PercentageWithinAgeGroup: " + (format(datum["PercentageWithinAgeGroup"], "")) + "; Age group: " + (isValid(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? isArray(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? join(datum["AgeGroup"], ' ') : datum["AgeGroup"] : ""+datum["AgeGroup"]) + "; Package level: " + (isValid(datum["Package Level"]) ? isArray(datum["Package Level"]) ? join(datum["Package Level"], ' ') : datum["Package Level"] : ""+datum["Package Level"]) + "; Recipients: " + (format(datum["Recipients"], ",")) + "; Total recipients in age group: " + (format(datum["AgeGroupTotal"], ",")) + "; Share of age group (%): " + (format(datum["PercentageWithinAgeGroup"], ".1f"))

"Package Level: " + (isValid(datum["Package Level"]) ? isArray(datum["Package Level"]) ? join(datum["Package Level"], ' ') : datum["Package Level"] : ""+datum["Package Level"]) + "; AgeGroup: " + (isValid(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? isArray(datum["AgeGroup"]) ? join(datum["AgeGroup"], ' ') : datum["AgeGroup"] : ""+datum["AgeGroup"]) + "; Label: " + (isValid(datum["Label"]) ? isArray(datum["Label"]) ? join(datum["Label"], ' ') : datum["Label"] : ""+datum["Label"])
